Master sheet → individual glyphs

32 independent enlargements from one fixed master and unaltered cell crops. Compare the source, registered enlargement and pixel disagreement.

Silhouette overlap after translation and uniform scale. Width is never stretched independently. This measures shape agreement; it does not establish common font metrics.

Master epsilon/kappa/phi variants are near-duplicates and need separate design review. Counter counting ignores pinholes smaller than four master pixels. The master itself supplies limited detail.
